name: What are the benefits of insulating my garage during a remodel?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of insulating my garage during a remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Insulating your garage during a remodel offers several benefits, especially if you plan to use the space for purposes other than parking. It helps maintain a more stable temperature, making the garage more comfortable year-round for workshops, gyms, or home offices. This can also lead to energy savings by preventing heat loss or gain, indirectly reducing heating and cooling costs for adjacent living areas. Maine Results, Inc. often recommends insulation as a practical tradeoff for enhanced comfort and energy efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: Insulating your garage provides a more stable temperature, making it comfortable for various uses, and can also lead to energy savings by preventing heat transfer.
